title: Flytrap Review
description: The Findings and Verdict of one Review. This is the contract between a Harness and the posting code (ADR 0001).

verdict.description: The overall judgment of the Review.

summary.description: A few sentences on what the change does and how it holds up.

findings.description: One entry per problem in the Changed lines. Empty when there are none.

file.description: Repository-relative path of the changed file.

line.description: Line number in the new version of the file where the problem starts.

end_line.description: Last line of the problem, when it spans several lines.

category.description: The Rubric category the problem falls under. spec is used only when a Spec was given.

severity.description: blocker must be fixed before merge, suggestion is recommended, nitpick is optional.

body.description: Why it is a problem and what to do about it.

suggestion.description: Optional replacement code for exactly the lines from line to end_line.
